messages:
Sara Lee: Heads up — planning to enable aurora-7b-v2 in the catalog at 22:00 PT during the 2h change window. Will do a 5% canary for 30m then ramp to 50% if telemetry looks good.

Mike: ok, what's the fallback ordering? need to avoid the quant-v1 spike we saw last time.

Sara Lee: fallback priority: aurora-7b-v1 -> aurora-7b-quant -> base-small. If v2 fails, traffic should land on v1 (non-quant) first. I'll pin v1 for 1h after enable for easier rollback.

Kim: +1. Add a TTL on fallback so the auto-shift doesn't ping-pong. 5m cooloff.

DeployBot: preflight checks passed: model binary verified, weights hash OK, infra capacity OK, no slot conflicts. Canary route created: canary-aurora-7b-v2 -> 5%.

OpsOncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Monitoring checklist posted in release doc: latency, 5xx rate, queue depth, token cost delta. Link: https://internal/release/aurora-v2

Ian: Suggest we also set a soft cap on token cost +20% alert so we can mute traffic before SLO breaks.

Mike: If we see memory OOMs, what's rollback plan? full rollback to v1 or staged drain + pin older variant?

Sara Lee: rollback plan: immediate deploybot-triggered drain from canary and 1) pin traffic to aurora-7b-v1, 2) disable v2 in catalog, 3) open rollback incident with SRE. Expect ~5min failover.

DeployBot: noted — will run `deploybot rollback --catalog aurora-7b-v2 --to aurora-7b-v1` on trigger. Make sure `ops-rollback` label is on the incident for auto-metrics.

Kim: I'll add the release note blurb now and mention the fallback ordering + rollback steps.

Sara Lee: Great. Final checklist before 22:00: confirm canary alarms (Mike), confirm DDoS/ratelimit guards (Kim), OpsOncall ack (OpsOncall). Reply here when done.

OpsOncall: acked. Monitoring dashboards pinned.

Mike: canary alarms set and smoke tests passing. ready.

Sara Lee: starting canary at 22:00 PT. I'll post updates. :rocket:
